name: dock-pick-and-drop
summary: Pick-up, reorder, remove and drop interaction for an icon dock. The held icon is glued to the pointer; everything else is a spring.

states.idle: Nothing held. Hover magnification allowed (mouse only).
states.armed: Pointer is down on an icon but not yet lifted. Icon scales to 0.92. Release here is a tap (launch hop).
states.reorder: Icon is lifted and inside the dock zone. Neighbours part around a dashed landing slot.
states.intent: Lifted icon is far enough above the dock to mean remove. Icon shrinks and fades, gap closes, label reads Release to remove.
states.dropping: Released inside the dock. Order committed, icon springs into its slot carrying pointer velocity.
states.removing: Released in intent. Icon scales and fades out, toast offers Undo.
states.returning: Cancelled (Esc, blur, pointercancel). Order untouched, icon springs back to its original slot.

transitions.guard: no other active pointer, primary button

transitions.trigger: pointer more than 52 px above dock top
pointer less than 28 px above dock top

invariants: I1 Single pointer: ignore a second pointerdown while one is armed or held.
I2 Glue: the held icon's position is assigned from the pointer every frame. Never animate it with a spring or CSS transition.
I3 Deferred commit: the order array only changes on drop or remove. During a drag only insertIdx changes, so cancel is free.
I4 Pure layout: every non-held icon's target slot is a pure function of (order, held, insertIdx, intent). No hidden layout state.
I5 Terminates: every state reaches idle. Decide idle from a rest test on springs, and add a watchdog (force idle after 1500 ms) as a last resort.
I6 Momentum: on release, copy pointer velocity into the icon's spring velocity so the settle continues the gesture.
I7 Hysteresis: swap slots only after the icon centre passes 0.62 of a slot, so boundaries never flicker. Intent has separate enter and exit thresholds.
I8 Stable integration: step springs in substeps of at most 8 ms and clamp frame dt to 33 ms, so a background tab or a long frame cannot explode the simulation.
I9 Centre-based hit testing: resolve the target slot from the dragged icon's centre, not its edges, and measure the dock rect each frame because its width animates.
I10 Undo restores the original index, clamped to the current length.
I11 Reduced motion: replace springs with near-instant ones and disable tilt and magnify. State logic stays identical.
I12 Keyboard parity: Space picks up, arrows move, Space drops, Esc cancels, Delete removes, Ctrl/Cmd+Z undoes. Every step is announced in an aria-live region.
gotchas: A unary minus directly before ** is a SyntaxError in JavaScript (for example -(d/72)**2). Write -((d/72)*(d/72)). One such line silently blanked the whole page.
Set touch-action: none on icons or the browser will scroll and fire pointercancel mid-drag.
Wrap setPointerCapture in try/catch. It throws if the pointer is already gone.
Do not put CSS transitions on transform for icons that JS also drives. They fight, and the icon feels laggy.
getBoundingClientRect includes scale. Compute the grab offset from the unscaled slot position, not the rect of a scaled icon.
Raise z-index while an icon is held and while it is still settling, otherwise it slides under its neighbours on drop.
Cancel on window blur and pointercancel, or an icon can stay lifted forever.
jsdom has no matchMedia. Stub it when smoke-testing so the script reaches the end.

test_scenarios.name: tap
test_scenarios.steps: pointerdown, pointerup within 100 ms and under 6 px
test_scenarios.expect: state idle, order unchanged, hop played

test_scenarios.name: reorder right
test_scenarios.steps: hold icon 0, drag past 1.3 slots, release
test_scenarios.expect: icon now index 1, neighbours moved, state returns to idle

test_scenarios.name: boundary jitter
test_scenarios.steps: hover pointer at 0.6 to 0.64 slots repeatedly
test_scenarios.expect: no slot flicker (insertIdx changes at most once)

test_scenarios.name: remove
test_scenarios.steps: lift, drag 60 px above dock, release
test_scenarios.expect: icon removed, toast visible, dock narrower by one slot

test_scenarios.name: cancel
test_scenarios.expect: icon returns to original slot, order unchanged

test_scenarios.name: second pointer
test_scenarios.steps: lift with pointer A, pointerdown with pointer B

test_scenarios.name: regrab mid settle
test_scenarios.steps: drop, immediately grab the same icon

test_scenarios.name: keyboard
test_scenarios.steps: focus icon, Space, ArrowRight twice, Space
test_scenarios.expect: moved two slots, announcements read, state idle

test_scenarios.name: reduced motion
test_scenarios.expect: same end state, no visible overshoot

test_scenarios.name: single icon
test_scenarios.expect: lift and drop work, no NaN positions
